name: Browser default rendering
summary: Using the raw look of a browser, with no style sheet, as the surface of a work.
how: Keep the default Times 16px text and blue links.
Choose one flat ground: white, grey or black.
Show a frame, an error or the source as visible content.
Add no images, or one stretched GIF.

origin.note: The first graphical browsers showed every page in the same default style, and artists treated that look as a material.

adoptions.via: Net artists use frames, raw text and links as the work, for example on the pages of Jodi.
